method.geometryOracle: Independent Python Sutherland-Hodgman clipping of serialized rings to each nominal glyph rectangle, followed by signed shoelace area. The oracle did not call clipper2-ts or the shared geometry validator.
method.sourceOracle: Compiled B0 primitive anchors, point coordinates, Composite worldBounds, and leaf ancestorCompositeIds.
method.eventYPolicy: Candidates provide no Event Y override; existing B0 primitive Event and Composite anchor Y remains authoritative. Region boundary Y is separate.

review.conclusion: No material source-identity, membership-count, or nominal glyph inclusion/exclusion discrepancy was found in the pinned artifact. Both candidates preserve exact B0 X and semantic world bounds and retain every source leaf membership as area or explicit list fallback.
review.determinism: Reviewed sorted identity traversal, deterministic skeleton/channel selection, canonical ring serialization, and passing source-order reversal regressions.
review.rendererScope: This record reviews serialized source geometry. GPU triangulation, painter recovery, and deployed browser behavior require separate evidence.

limitations: The independent oracle uses floating-point serialized coordinates and an area tolerance, not exact-arithmetic topology proof.
Nominal 5 by 5 glyph supports and obstacle offset settings do not certify changing screen-space glyph or label footprints at every zoom.
Proper self-crossing counts are construction-validator evidence; they are not an independent proof against every non-adjacent touch, collinear overlap, or inter-ring topology defect.
A component or hole count does not certify semantic membership-intersection signatures or a single connected region for every Composite.
Global semantic area certification and recovery of missing temporal sidecar information remain unverified.
